rule.title: Social security benefits are the income of the person with the legal right to them

when_missing.because: Benefits on a statement in the taxpayer's name are theirs unless a preparer says otherwise

citation.wording: Benefits are included in the taxable income (to the extent they are taxable) of the person who has the legal right to receive the benefits.

rule.open_point: When a check covers both the taxpayer and a child, only the taxpayer's part is used — an amount the form does not print; only an answer covering the whole box is applied.
